record.context_brief: Bubble towers at fixed positive parameter
record.original_question: For the Brezis-Nirenberg Dirichlet problem -Delta u = lambda u + |u|^(2*-2)u in a general bounded domain Omega, do there exist bubble-tower sign-changing solutions at a fixed positive parameter value lambda when N >= 4, and analogously when N = 3 with lambda > lambda*?

evidence.quote: Besides, there is no analysis of bubble-tower solutions of the Brezis-Nirenberg problem (1.1) as lambda -> lambdabar > 0 for N >= 4 (lambdabar > lambda* for N = 3), thus, we also want to ask

Open question 10: In a general bounded domain Omega, does there exist bubble-tower solutions of sign-changing solutions of the Brezis-Nirenberg problem (1.1) at a fixed paramter lambda > 0 for N >= 4 (lambda > lambda* for N = 3)?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Omega\subset\mathbb{R}^N$ be a bounded smooth domain with $N\ge 3$, and let $2^*=\frac{2N}{N-2}$ denote the critical Sobolev exponent. Consider the Brezis–Nirenberg problem
\[
\begin{cases} -\Delta u = \lambda u + |u|^{2^*-2}u & \text{in } \Omega,\\ u=0 & \text{on } \partial\Omega,\end{cases}
\]
where $\lambda>0$ is a real parameter. A family of sign-changing solutions $\{u_n\}$ is called a bubble-tower (or tower-of-bubbles) solution if, after rescaling, $u_n$ behaves asymptotically as a superposition of standard Aubin–Talenti bubbles
\[
U_{\delta,\xi}(x)=\Big(\tfrac{N(N-2)\delta^2}{\delta^2+|x-\xi|^2}\Big)^{(N-2)/2}
\]
of alternating signs, concentrating at a single point of $\Omega$ with concentration parameters of different orders, i.e. $u_n(x)\approx\sum_{j=1}^{k}(-1)^{j-1}U_{\delta_{j,n},\xi_n}(x)+o(1)$ in $H^1_0(\Omega)$ with $\delta_{j+1,n}/\delta_{j,n}\to 0$.

Let $\lambda^*=\lambda^*(\Omega)\in(0,\lambda_1(\Omega))$ denote the threshold value below which the problem has no positive solution when $N=3$ (so that for $N\ge 4$ no such restriction is needed).

Question: For a general bounded smooth domain $\Omega$, do there exist bubble-tower sign-changing solutions of the above problem at a fixed parameter value $\lambda>0$ when $N\ge 4$, and at a fixed $\lambda>\lambda^*$ when $N=3$?
artifact.status_search_result: Existing constructions of bubble-tower sign-changing solutions for the Brezis–Nirenberg problem are perturbative: either as $\lambda\to 0^+$ in symmetric domains and high dimensions ($N\ge 7$, Pistoia–Weth and subsequent works), or as $\lambda$ approaches a Dirichlet eigenvalue (recent works in dimensions 4 and 5 by Li and collaborators). Nonexistence results in low dimensions ($N=4,5,6$) for small $\lambda$ are also known. No construction at a fixed positive $\lambda$ in a general bounded domain (for $N\ge 4$, or for $\lambda>\lambda^*$ when $N=3$) appears in the literature, so the problem remains open.

status_evidence.title: Sign-changing tower of bubbles for the Brezis-Nirenberg problem
status_evidence.snippet: Tower-of-two-bubbles solutions are constructed in symmetric domains for N≥7 and ε>0 sufficiently small.
status_evidence.claim: Existing bubble-tower constructions require the parameter to be small (perturbative regime), not a fixed positive value.

status_evidence.title: Construction of bubbling solutions of the Brezis-Nirenberg problem in general bounded domains (I): dimensions 4 and 5
status_evidence.snippet: Bubbling solutions are constructed when λ is close to eigenvalues of the Dirichlet Laplacian via Lyapunov–Schmidt reduction.
status_evidence.claim: Recent constructions concern λ near eigenvalues, leaving the fixed-λ regime in general domains unaddressed.

status_evidence.title: On Brezis-Nirenberg problems: Open questions and new results in dimension six
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses open questions including existence of bubble-tower sign-changing solutions at fixed positive parameter.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is explicitly listed as open in recent literature.
